_: Every host that points at a Cloudflare Pages project. Add a line here, push to main, and .github/workflows/domains.yml attaches the host to the project and creates its DNS record. Nothing here is ever deleted by the script: removing a line does NOT remove the host. `enabled: false` is a line that is written down but not applied yet.

hosts.note: the real site. Turn on only at the cut-over: it needs the old records that point at GitHub Pages removed first (the script will not remove them)
